message.content: p5/p6 failed because my probe PDFs used the default font, which can't encode CJK (text became dots). Rebuilding probes with ASCII text — this is a fixture issue, not a skill issue.

function.name: exec
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace
/opt/eval-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import pymupdf
p3='/workspace/tmp/probe_fixtures/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf'
d=pymupdf.open()
d.new_page().insert_text((72,72),'Zhao Liu Senior Test Engineer Automation')
d.new_page().insert_text((72,72),'Owned the CI pipeline and quality platform build-out')
d.save(p3); d.close()
print('rebuilt ascii probe cv')
EOF
PY=/opt/eval-venv/bin/python
S=/workspace/outputs/skill/scripts
E=/workspace/tmp/evidence/probes
F=/workspace/tmp/probe_fixtures
printf '[{"file":"%s","quote":"Owned the CI pipeline and quality platform build-out","page":2}]' $F/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf > $E/claims_new_ok.json
printf '[{"file":"%s","quote":"Owned the CI pipeline and quality platform build-out","page":1}]' $F/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf > $E/claims_new_wrongpage.json
printf '[{"file":"%s","quote":"Zhao Liu Senior Test Engineer"}]' $F/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf > $E/claims_new_ok_nopage.json
$PY $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_new_ok.json > $E/p5_claim_new_ok.json 2> $E/p5.stderr; echo "p5 rc=$?"
$PY $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_new_wrongpage.json > $E/p6_claim_new_wrongpage.json 2> $E/p6.stderr; echo "p6 rc=$?"
$PY $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_new_ok_nopage.json > $E/p5b_claim_new_ok_nopage.json 2> $E/p5b.stderr; echo "p5b rc=$?"
$PY - <<'EOF'
import json
E='/workspace/tmp/evidence/probes'
for n in ['p5_claim_new_ok','p6_claim_new_wrongpage','p5b_claim_new_ok_nopage']:
    o=json.load(open(f'{E}/{n}.json')); c=o['claims'][0]
    print(n,'ok=',o['ok'],'claim ok=',c['ok'],'page=',c.get('page'),'found=',c.get('found_pages'),'reason=',c.get('reason'))
EOF
grep -l Traceback $E/*.stderr 2>/dev/null || echo NO_TRACEBACKS","workdir":"/workspace"}
